# incusos_system_storage (Data Source)

Reads IncusOS physical drives, root partition usage, and ZFS storage pools from `GET /1.0/system/storage`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `drives` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--drives))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pool_names` (List of String)
- `root_partition_available_in_bytes` (Number)
- `root_partition_size_in_bytes` (Number)
- `scrub_schedule` (String)
- `trim_schedule` (String)
